items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He finally called. I said, “Oh, good to hear from you.”

ctx.x: You’re talking about To Know Her . . .?

Yeah, because I said to Jan – I said, Jan, so many people think of The In Crowd and Wade in the Water. They think of that kind of music when they think of me. So maybe when the Geoffrey people said, we’ll get the choreographer, in their heads was that kind of music. So I had gone so far as to make a CD of some of that kind of music, to send to the choreographer. No, I did make the CD, and I was about to send it to the choreographer, Donald Byrd, renowned choreographer. Jan said, “You’re crazy. You should send him…
Were you thinking dance and movement while you were writing To Know Her . . .?
